# Workbook fixtures

- `basic.xlsx`: minimal two-sheet OOXML ZIP created by `scripts/create-fixture.mjs`; also shipped as the demo download. It contains shared/rich/inline strings, numeric/boolean values, formulas and RGB styles. It was read successfully by openpyxl 3.1.5 as an independent interoperability check.
- `openpyxl.xlsx`: independently generated by openpyxl 3.1.5 using `scripts/create-interop-fixture.py`. It covers Unicode and escaped text, two sheets, cross-sheet formulas, the 1904 epoch, date format metadata and explicit RGB/font/fill styles. The binary is checked in; Python is not required for tests or builds.

Neither fixture is claimed to be authored by Microsoft Excel. Real Excel and LibreOffice corpus coverage remains roadmap work.

- `layout.xlsx`: openpyxl-generated layout regression workbook, also available as the demo's layout sample. Covers wide columns, wrapped merged titles, custom row heights, a hidden column and row, frozen row/column panes, value/custom filters, and saved descending sort metadata. It includes 60 rows and 20 columns so scroll/freeze behavior can be exercised in a browser.
